description: Implementation of rx::FenceNV11 and rx::Sync11 classes for Direct3D 11 fences and synchronization, including helper functions for setting and testing fences, and handling GPU command synchronization.

classes.name: FenceNV11
classes.description: Represents a Direct3D 11 fence object for synchronization, with methods to set, test, and finish the fence.

classes.name: Sync11
classes.description: Implements a Windows high-resolution timer based synchronization object for GPU command synchronization.

methods.name: FenceSetHelper
methods.description: Helper template function to set a fence by creating a query if needed and ending it.

methods.name: FenceTestHelper
methods.description: Helper template function to test if a fence has completed by retrieving query data.

methods.name: FenceNV11::test
methods.description: Tests if the fence has been signaled.

methods.name: FenceNV11::finish
methods.description: Blocks until the fence is signaled, polling repeatedly.

methods.name: Sync11::clientWait
methods.description: Waits for the fence to be signaled with a timeout.

methods.name: Sync11::getStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of the fence.
